full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen illustration shows an elegantly dressed woman standing among guests around a dining table against a lightly sketched interior. The pale background is mostly open paper, with a few straight lines at the upper right suggesting a framed wall or doorway. Near the upper center, an older man in a dark suit stands behind the woman, his head and shoulders defined by short, close strokes. The woman occupies the center of the gathering. Her large dark hat, high collar, fitted bodice, and full sleeves make a strong black silhouette against the white paper. Fine white gaps cut through the dense ink on her clothes, separating trim, folds, and the line of her waist. Her face turns slightly toward the seated guests, with the eyes, nose, and mouth drawn in delicate marks that contrast with the forceful dark costume. At the left edge, a seated man leans toward another guest; his jacket is built from diagonal hatching and his light profile stands out against it. Beside him, a smaller partly hidden figure bends toward the center of the table. On the right, a seated man in a dark jacket looks up toward the standing woman, his head turned in profile and one arm close to the tabletop. Across the lower middle, cups, stemmed glasses, plates, and a bottle are suggested by thin contours and small black accents. The tablecloth remains largely white, preserving space between the closely grouped bodies. Quick parallel lines and crosshatching give the jackets and hair weight, while the surrounding room stays spare and pale. The light reads as even interior illumination, with contrast created mainly by ink density rather than a strong cast shadow. The overall composition is lively and socially crowded, its elegant figures held together by a dark central silhouette and a network of swift, precise pen marks.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白钢笔插画描绘一位盛装女子站在围桌而坐的宾客之间，背后是略加勾勒的室内空间。浅色背景大多保留纸张空白，右上方几道直线暗示墙上的画框或门口。靠近上部中央，一名年长男子穿深色西装站在女子身后，头部和肩部由短而密的线条界定。女子位于聚会中心。宽大的深色帽子、高领、收腰衣身和饱满的衣袖，在白纸上形成强烈的黑色剪影。细小的白色空隙切开衣服上密集的墨色，分出装饰、褶皱和腰线。她的脸微微转向坐着的宾客，眼、鼻、嘴由细致的笔迹描出，与有力的深色服装形成对比。左边缘，一名坐着的男子向另一位宾客倾身；他的外套由斜向排线构成，浅色侧脸从中突显。旁边，一位部分被挡住的较小人物朝桌子中央俯身。右侧，一名穿深色外套的男子坐着抬头看向站立的女子，侧脸转向她，一只手臂靠近桌面。下方中部的杯子、高脚杯、盘子和瓶子，由纤细轮廓和小块黑色重音提示。桌布大部分保持白色，在密集的人物之间留出呼吸空间。快速的平行线和交叉排线赋予外套与头发重量，周围房间则保持稀疏浅淡。光线读作均匀的室内照明，对比主要来自墨色的疏密，而非强烈的投影。整体构图热闹而拥挤，中央深色剪影与迅捷准确的笔线网络把衣着讲究的人物连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The illustration relies on agile black ink lines over a generous white ground. Parallel hatching and tight crosshatching deepen selected masses, while exposed paper carries highlights and breathing room. Outlines vary between quick broken contours and precise dark accents; the darkest regions remain compact instead of filling the whole frame. Small curls, folds, and surface marks are described with economical strokes, giving rich detail without uniform finish. The palette stays in black, off-white, and many intermediate grays made by line density rather than wash. Light feels broadly even, so changes in value come from the drawing's concentration of marks. Overlapping shapes form a shallow social rhythm, with one strong vertical dark area surrounded by lighter clustered contours. The overall effect is elegant, lively, and editorial, balancing expressive sketchwork with controlled graphic contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 插画依靠灵活的黑色墨线和宽裕的白色底面构成。平行排线与紧密交叉排线加深选定的体块，裸露纸面则承载高光和呼吸空间。轮廓在迅速断开的线条与精确的深色重音之间变化；最暗处保持集中，没有铺满全幅。细小的卷曲、褶纹和表面痕迹由节制的笔画说明，细节丰富却不处处修饰到同样程度。配色停留在黑、灰白和由线条密度产生的多层次灰色，并非水洗晕染。光感宽泛均匀，明度变化主要来自笔迹的聚散。重叠形状形成浅层空间中的群聚节奏，一块有力的竖向深色区域被更浅的密集轮廓环绕。整体效果优雅而生动，带有编辑插画气息，在表现性的速写笔势与受控的图形对比之间取得平衡。
theme_en: An elegantly dressed woman among diners at a crowded table
theme_zh: 一位盛装女子站在围桌而坐的宾客之间
name: Charles Dana Gibson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
